name: l0_ambient_source_resume
about: CAmbientGeneric::vfunc113 0x101ac9c0 is slot 113, CBaseEntity::Activate's override, run once per level activation by ServerActivate 0x1011aaf0 (walks/L0-r006.md), not a per-frame think. H0: the cached source handle +0x4c8 is valid iff it is not -1, its serial matches the handle table's record and the record holds an entity. H1: invalid with a SourceEntityName -> FindEntityByName 0x100f7770 -> the found entity's GetRefEHandle, else -1. H2: still invalid -> this entity's own handle (self), written without a test. H3: m_fActive -> the activation emission FUN_101cdac0 (flags m_nSndFlags | 0x8, volume +0x4a4 * 0.01, level +0x454, pitch +0x494, the SOURCE entity's GetAbsOrigin) and m_flNextThink = curtime + 0.1, the first run of the modulation think FUN_101acb70. H4: inactive -> the handle is resolved, nothing is emitted, no think is armed. Nothing else re-resolves the handle: InputPitch 0x101ac690 reads the cached handle only, so a killed anchor silences it (the pitch word is still written) until the next Activate pass, which finds no entity of that name, writes -1 and falls back to self. A later pass with a valid cached handle looks nothing up (H0 short-circuits).

expect.label: src_bound
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::vfunc113 va=0x101ac9c0 phase=write field=m_hSoundSource value=anchor via=lookup m_fActive=1

expect.label: src_emit
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::vfunc113 va=0x101ac9c0 phase=emit flags=0x8 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=100 origin=.* source=anchor name=impact/physics/metal/hit_hard1.wav

expect.label: self_emit
expect.match: phase=emit flags=0x8 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=100 origin=.* source=self

expect.label: resume_emit
expect.match: fn=CAmbientGeneric::vfunc113 va=0x101ac9c0 phase=emit flags=0x8 vol=1.00 level=70 pitch=120 origin=.* source=self

notes: The rows are activated by the stage's own pass at scenario zero (the arena host's ActivateRuntime), which is the ServerActivate pass itself; the two later entity_call Activate are the pass a save restore runs on the same entities. The anchor is itself a start-silent ambient_generic: any named entity serves as a source, and this one needs no body. The re-spawned anchor at 2.0 is not re-bound by the 2.4 pass: the cached self handle is valid, so H0 skips H1.
